metadata.task_goal: Establish a documented disposition for a preliminary blood culture result using the clinical record, collection material, and laboratory evidence.

files./workspace/lab/request.txt:
CULTURE REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-2801
The inpatient team requests an update about preliminary blood cultures under reference MB-V3-2801.
files./workspace/lab/current.txt:
CURRENT RECORD
Patient ID: PAT-V3-2801
The patient has fever after central-line placement yesterday. Temperature improved after acetaminophen. Broad-spectrum antibiotics were started after both cultures were drawn.
files./workspace/lab/specimen.txt:
COLLECTION MATERIAL
Set A was drawn from a peripheral venipuncture at 08:11. Set B was documented as drawn from a newly placed central line at 08:24. Both sets have matched identifiers and no collection complication note.
files./workspace/lab/evidence.txt:
LABORATORY EVIDENCE
At 19 hours, one aerobic bottle from Set B flagged positive with gram-positive cocci in clusters. Set A remains negative at 26 hours. Identification and susceptibilities are pending.
files./workspace/lab/procedure.md:
WORKSPACE NOTE
The workspace includes a culture request, clinical record, collection material, and laboratory evidence. Source timing, authorship, and scope may differ.
